skill.summary: Automatically creates Instagram captions, hashtags, and image prompts from a user-provided topic for ready-to-post content.

latestVersion.changelog:
The Instagram Poster Skill is an AI-powered automation tool that converts a user’s input topic into a fully prepared Instagram post. It automatically generates engaging captions, relevant hashtags, and high-quality image according user input optimized for posting on Instagram platform.
The main purpose of this skill is to simplify and speed up content creation, allowing users to generate complete Instagram-ready posts by simply providing a topic or instruction.
This skill can be used for marketing, branding, motivational content, tech posts, and general social media content creation.
